goals: Verify the availability and correct response content of the ESGF THREDDS root catalog
Verify the successful retrieval and correct content type of CMIP5 and CMIP6 NetCDF files from the THREDDS file server
activities: Send a GET request to the catalog endpoint and verify the response text contains 'Earth System Root catalog'
Send a HEAD request to a CMIP6 file endpoint and verify the 'Content-Type' header is 'application/x-netcdf'
Send a GET request to a CMIP6 file endpoint and verify the 'Content-Type' header is 'application/x-netcdf'
Send a GET request to a second CMIP6 file endpoint and verify the 'Content-Type' header is 'application/x-netcdf'
Send a GET request to a CMIP5 file endpoint and verify the response is successful
Send a GET request to a second CMIP5 file endpoint and verify the response is successful
